subject: Dasco Pickshine
fact: Dasco Pickshine is the owner of Pickshine Mines for Dasco Pickshine Mines, who sewed a Dasco Pickshine patch onto Daz's clothes, standing proudly beside the much taller dragonborn, and every piece of his clothing and equipment bore his company's logo.
source_quote: Dasco Pickshine, the owner of Pickshine Mines for Dasco Pickshine Mines, seized every opportunity to promote his brand. He offered "branded tea" and explained his holistic approach to marketing the mining operation. When the party showed interest in branded items, he personally sewed a Dasco Pickshine patch onto Daz's clothes, standing proudly beside the much taller dragonborn. Every piece of Dasco Pickshine's clothing and equipment bore his company's logo.

subject: Chipgrin
fact: Chipgrin led wererats who took offense at any suggestion they might be noisy, emphasized their stealth capabilities, and agreed to scout ahead while the other allies waited in reserve at area twenty-two.
source_quote: Chipgrin and his wererats, taking offense at any suggestion they might be noisy, emphasized their stealth capabilities and agreed to scout ahead while the other allies waited in reserve at area twenty-two.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz was formally recognized as the general in charge, with Grygum and Zalthir serving as lieutenants who could also give orders.
source_quote: Daz was formally recognized as the general in charge, with Grygum and Zalthir serving as lieutenants who could also give orders.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum, with a flash of insight, realized that Jimjar hadn't specified how Thorin should cross and persuaded the dwarf that he could simply walk across the bridge once it was built.
source_quote: Grygum, with a flash of insight, realized that Jimjar hadn't specified how Thorin should cross and persuaded the dwarf that he could simply walk across the bridge once it was built.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin initially considered the more dramatic option of jumping, but his sentient sword Dawnbringer argued against getting stuck in acid, and after a brief dialogue between dwarf and blade, Thorin agreed that walking would be just as satisfying.
source_quote: Thorin initially considered the more dramatic option of jumping, but his sentient sword Dawnbringer argued against getting stuck in acid. After a brief dialogue between dwarf and blade, Thorin agreed that walking would be just as satisfying.

subject: Dawnbringer
fact: Dawnbringer is a sentient sword that argued against Thorin getting stuck in acid, influencing his decision to walk across the bridge.
source_quote: his sentient sword Dawnbringer argued against getting stuck in acid.

subject: Jimjar
fact: Jimjar made a bet that Thorin couldn't clear the gap with his pack on, and later made a joke about Daz's reflection being better looking than the real thing.
source_quote: Jimjar made a bet that Thorin couldn't clear the gap with his pack on. ... Jimjar made a joke about Daz's reflection being better looking than the real thing.

subject: Chipgrin
fact: Chipgrin offered two options: his pack could howl at a frequency that would drown out the psychic effect, allowing the party to walk through safely, but this would draw all the oozes to attack the wererats, leaving the party without scouts or backup.
source_quote: Chipgrin offered two options: his pack could howl at a frequency that would drown out the psychic effect, allowing the party to walk through safely, but this would draw all the oozes to attack the wererats, leaving the party without scouts or backup.

subject: Glabbagool
fact: Glabbagool is an intelligent ooze who promised he would never hurt his friends, but recalled an earlier incident where he had heard a voice calling him from a large pool of slimes, suggesting the Pudding King might have some influence over him.
source_quote: Glabbagool suggested getting inside him to pass through safely, though this would cause acid burns and oxygen deprivation. ... The intelligent ooze promised he would never hurt his friends. However, he recalled an earlier incident where he had heard a voice calling him from a large pool of slimes, suggesting the Pudding King might have some influence over him.

subject: The Pudding King
fact: The Pudding King monologued to his two ooze henchmen, Princess Ebonheir and Prince Livid, gloating about the impending defeat of Blingdenstone, cheering as he described members of the Blingdenstone army being consumed by oozes, and ranting that Zuggtmoy thought she could take his kingdom but Juiblex had promised it to him.
source_quote: The party observed the Pudding King monologuing to his two ooze henchmen, Princess Ebonheir and Prince Livid. He gloated about the impending defeat of Blingdenstone, periodically cheering as he described members of the Blingdenstone army being consumed by oozes. He also ranted that Zuggtmoy, the Queen of Rot, thought she could take his kingdom, but Juiblex had promised it to him.

subject: Princess Ebonheir
fact: Princess Ebonheir is one of the Pudding King's two ooze henchmen, present in the throne room as he monologued.
source_quote: The Pudding King monologuing to his two ooze henchmen, Princess Ebonheir and Prince Livid.

subject: Prince Livid
fact: Prince Livid is one of the Pudding King's two ooze henchmen, present in the throne room as he monologued.
source_quote: The Pudding King monologuing to his two ooze henchmen, Princess Ebonheir and Prince Livid.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir manifested his tentacles and prepared to fly as the Earth Elemental smashed through the ochre jelly barricade, was hurled thirty feet into the throne room, teleported an additional sixty feet closer to the Pudding King, walked the final forty-five feet to reach him, struck the gnomish villain, and successfully wrapped his tentacles around him in a grapple.
source_quote: Zalthir manifested his tentacles and prepared to fly as the Earth Elemental smashed through the ochre jelly barricade. The elemental then hurled Zalthir thirty feet into the throne room, and the dragonborn teleported an additional sixty feet closer to the Pudding King before walking the final forty-five feet to reach him. Zalthir struck the gnomish villain and successfully wrapped his tentacles around him in a grapple.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir maintained his grip on the Pudding King after he transformed into an ooze form and used his remaining movement to drag the Pudding King fifteen feet south, away from his ooze allies.
source_quote: In response to being grappled, the Pudding King transformed into an ooze form, his body becoming a shifting, amorphous mass. Despite the transformation, Zalthir maintained his grip and used his remaining movement to drag the Pudding King fifteen feet south, away from his ooze allies.

subject: area twenty-two
fact: The other allies waited in reserve at area twenty-two.
source_quote: agreed to scout ahead while the other allies waited in reserve at area twenty-two.

subject: Blingdenstone
fact: Blingdenstone is the town whose civilian areas Senni Diggermattock feared for, and whose biomass the Pudding King was trying to convert into ooze biomass by having his creatures consume everyone.
source_quote: Senni Diggermattock, her face etched with concern, explained her fears for the civilian areas of Blingdenstone... The Pudding King had made an alliance with the demon lord Juiblex and was trying to convert Blingdenstone's biomass into ooze biomass by having his creatures consume everyone.

subject: the throne room
fact: The throne room had green slime patches on the ceiling throughout that could drop on anyone standing beneath them, and the heavy stone doors were visible through the semi-clear body of the ochre jelly.
source_quote: The party noted green slime patches on the ceiling throughout the throne room that could drop on anyone standing beneath them. ... The heavy stone doors to the throne room were visible through the jelly's semi-clear body.

subject: the grand vaulted corridor
fact: The grand vaulted corridor was barred by a massive, quivering wall of translucent ochre jelly, which filled the hallway from floor to ceiling, pulsing with a rhythmic thrum that matched the Pudding King's own heartbeat.
source_quote: the party observed a grand vaulted corridor barred by a massive, quivering wall of translucent ochre jelly. The creature filled the hallway from floor to ceiling, pulsing with a rhythmic thrum that matched the Pudding King's own heartbeat.

subject: the twenty-foot stretch of passageway
fact: The twenty-foot stretch of passageway had been hollowed out into a pulsating pit of black pudding, with an acid-dripping ceiling above.
source_quote: A twenty-foot stretch of passageway had been hollowed out into a pulsating pit of black pudding, with an acid-dripping ceiling above.

subject: the tunnel walls
fact: The tunnel walls had transformed into sheets of gelatinous slime acting as dark, weeping mirrors with psychic effects, and a "brain slime" in the ceiling emitted a rhythmic, wet clicking and sang a psychic song that turned minds into puddles.
source_quote: the tunnel walls had transformed into sheets of gelatinous slime acting as dark, weeping mirrors with psychic effects. A "brain slime" in the ceiling emitted a rhythmic, wet clicking and sang a psychic song that turned minds into puddles.

subject: mithral braces
fact: Dasco Pickshine offered that his miners could bridge the pit using mithral braces and salt neutralizers.
source_quote: Dasco Pickshine immediately offered a solution: his miners could bridge the pit using mithral braces and salt neutralizers.

subject: salt neutralizers
fact: Dasco Pickshine offered that his miners could bridge the pit using mithral braces and salt neutralizers.
source_quote: Dasco Pickshine immediately offered a solution: his miners could bridge the pit using mithral braces and salt neutralizers.

subject: branded tea
fact: Dasco Pickshine offered "branded tea" as part of his holistic approach to marketing the mining operation.
source_quote: He offered "branded tea" and explained his holistic approach to marketing the mining operation.

subject: Dasco Pickshine patch
fact: Dasco Pickshine personally sewed a Dasco Pickshine patch onto Daz's clothes.
source_quote: he personally sewed a Dasco Pickshine patch onto Daz's clothes

subject: black pudding
fact: A black pudding formed a pulsating pit in a twenty-foot stretch of passageway with an acid-dripping ceiling.
source_quote: A twenty-foot stretch of passageway had been hollowed out into a pulsating pit of black pudding, with an acid-dripping ceiling above.

subject: gelatinous slime
fact: Gelatinous slime formed sheets in the tunnel walls, acting as dark, weeping mirrors with psychic effects.
source_quote: the tunnel walls had transformed into sheets of gelatinous slime acting as dark, weeping mirrors with psychic effects.

subject: brain slime
fact: A brain slime in the ceiling emitted a rhythmic, wet clicking and sang a psychic song that turned minds into puddles.
source_quote: A "brain slime" in the ceiling emitted a rhythmic, wet clicking and sang a psychic song that turned minds into puddles.

subject: ochre jelly
fact: Ochre jelly formed a massive, quivering wall filling a grand vaulted corridor from floor to ceiling, pulsing with a rhythmic thrum matching the Pudding King's heartbeat, with pseudopods lashing out to pull intruders into its acidic mass.
source_quote: a massive, quivering wall of translucent ochre jelly. The creature filled the hallway from floor to ceiling, pulsing with a rhythmic thrum that matched the Pudding King's own heartbeat. Thick pseudopods lashed out from the jelly, attempting to pull intruders into its acidic mass.

subject: green slime
fact: Green slime patches were on the ceiling throughout the throne room and could drop on anyone standing beneath them.
source_quote: The party noted green slime patches on the ceiling throughout the throne room that could drop on anyone standing beneath them.

subject: Earth Elemental
fact: The Earth Elemental smashed through the ochre jelly barricade and hurled Zalthir thirty feet into the throne room.
source_quote: the Earth Elemental smashed through the ochre jelly barricade. The elemental then hurled Zalthir thirty feet into the throne room.

subject: bat familiar
fact: Daz sent his bat familiar ahead to scout further, and it discovered the grand vaulted corridor barred by the ochre jelly, navigating through pseudopods successfully.
source_quote: Daz sent his bat familiar ahead to scout further, and it discovered a grand vaulted corridor barred by a massive, quivering wall of translucent ochre jelly. ... the bat navigated through them successfully.

subject: wererats
fact: Wererats led by Chipgrin were part of the allied forces who agreed to scout ahead and later howled at a frequency to drown out psychic effects, drawing all oozes to attack them.
source_quote: wererats led by Chipgrin ... Chipgrin offered two options: his pack could howl at a frequency that would drown out the psychic effect, allowing the party to walk through safely, but this would draw all the oozes to attack the wererats.

subject: Pickshine Miners
fact: The Pickshine Miners enthusiastically set to work, completing the bridge using mithral braces and salt neutralizers in about twenty minutes while singing cheerful songs.
source_quote: the Pickshine Miners enthusiastically set to work, completing the bridge in about twenty minutes while singing cheerful songs.

subject: Pudding King
fact: The Pudding King transformed into an ooze form after being grappled by Zalthir, becoming a shifting, amorphous mass capable of striking with deadly certainty.
source_quote: In response to being grappled, the Pudding King transformed into an ooze form, his body becoming a shifting, amorphous mass.

subject: Demon Lord Juiblex
fact: Juiblex is the demon lord who made an alliance with the Pudding King and promised him the kingdom of Blingdenstone.
source_quote: The Pudding King had made an alliance with the demon lord Juiblex and was trying to convert Blingdenstone's biomass into ooze biomass... Juiblex had promised it to him.

subject: Queen of Rot Zuggtmoy
fact: Zuggtmoy is the Queen of Rot who thought she could take the Pudding King's kingdom, according to his rants.
source_quote: He also ranted that Zuggtmoy, the Queen of Rot, thought she could take his kingdom, but Juiblex had promised it to him.

subject: bridge construction
fact: The Pickshine Miners completed a bridge over a black pudding pit using mithral braces and salt neutralizers in about twenty minutes while singing cheerful songs.
source_quote: the Pickshine Miners enthusiastically set to work, completing the bridge in about twenty minutes while singing cheerful songs.

subject: psychic howl
fact: Chipgrin's wererats howled at a frequency that drowned out the psychic song of the brain slime, drawing all oozes to attack them and leaving the party without scouts or backup.
source_quote: Chipgrin offered two options: his pack could howl at a frequency that would drown out the psychic effect, allowing the party to walk through safely, but this would draw all the oozes to attack the wererats, leaving the party without scouts or backup.

subject: smash through ochre jelly
fact: The Earth Elemental smashed through the ochre jelly barricade, allowing Zalthir to be hurled into the throne room.
source_quote: the Earth Elemental smashed through the ochre jelly barricade. The elemental then hurled Zalthir thirty feet into the throne room.

subject: grapple with the Pudding King
fact: Zalthir successfully wrapped his tentacles around the Pudding King in a grapple, then dragged him fifteen feet south away from his allies.
source_quote: Zalthir struck the gnomish villain and successfully wrapped his tentacles around him in a grapple. ... Zalthir maintained his grip and used his remaining movement to drag the Pudding King fifteen feet south, away from his ooze allies.

subject: scout capture
fact: The second wererat scout was caught and terrified, unable to move, after the tunnel walls transformed into gelatinous slime mirrors with psychic effects.
source_quote: The second wererat scout ventured further ahead but didn't return. ... Chipgrin went to investigate and found the scout caught and terrified, unable to move.

subject: signal sent
fact: The signal was sent, and the main distraction force began their attack, triggering the final assault on the Pudding King's throne room.
source_quote: The signal was sent, and the main distraction force began their attack.

subject: today
fact: Today is the day of victory against the Pudding King, as declared by Chief Dorbo Diggermattock.
source_quote: Chief Dorbo Diggermattock stood before the assembled forces, his voice ringing with conviction as he declared that today would be the day of victory against the Pudding King.
